name: context-engineering
title_zh: 开工前先铺好 AGENTS.md 和技能夹
tagline_zh: 新项目启动时，别让智能体在无关文件里瞎翻。这套脚手架一次生成规则、技能、压缩脚本和四款编辑器适配层。
tagline_en: Starting a project? Stop agents from rummaging blind. One scaffold lays down rules, skills, compression scripts.
desc_en: Scaffolds a portable context-engineering kit to cut coding-agent token waste: AGENTS.md, scoped rules, .agents/skills (bug-fix, test-targeted, log-triage), compression scripts, and thin Cursor/Claude Code/Copilot/Antigravity adapters. Use when starting a project, setting up context engineering, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, token efficiency, Agent Skills, or generating agent files and folders in Cursor, C
why_zh: 它把上下文工程从口头约定变成仓库里的实体文件：规则按作用域分层，技能按任务切块，压缩脚本定期瘦身。
why_en: Turns context engineering from folklore into committed files: scoped rules, task-sliced skills, and pruning scripts. Structural.
limit_zh: 只覆盖启动阶段的文件骨架，不包含运行时监控或自动调优；生成的压缩脚本需你自己接入 CI 或 cron。
limit_en: Scaffolds only at project start; no runtime monitoring or auto-tuning. Compression scripts need your own CI/cron hookup. Overkill for tiny.
title_en: Pre-wire AGENTS.md & skill folders to cut agent token waste
